cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a government contract with a foreign provider carries terms on data jurisdiction, portability, exit or source code. The national hosting fact covers the identity database only.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 60): the National Cloud Policy 2025 mandates in-country hosting of sensitive government data (NGA-025), and NIMC states the national identity database is hosted and run in Nigeria (NGA-024), so stage 4. The Central Bank's payment-data circular binds financial institutions, not state data, and is noted. Stage 5 needs a contract carrying data terms, and none is held.
